**Coaching note (80 words):**
After Black played Bb4, their bishop became loose and vulnerable. Your knight on d4 could fork it with the queen by playing Nxc6. Even if Black responds with a check (Bxc3+), you recapture with Qxc3, and after Black takes your knight (Bxc6), you've won a full piece for just some minor exchanges. Always scan for undefended enemy pieces that your pieces can attack—especially when a fork wins material decisively.
